subject: Urgent: CrestGate latency & 5xx surge — exec war-room coordination
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@crestgate.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: alicia.procurement@crestgate.com
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Severe latency spike and 5xx bursts impacting checkout

Naomi —

We’re seeing a dramatic increase in latency and a spike in 5xx errors on calls to Redwood’s text-generation endpoint (model: rdx-large-v2) starting ~07:50 PT. Checkout throughput is dropping ~30% and several merchants are seeing failed payments because the request queue is timing out. Our SREs captured a few stacks and error patterns; attaching a trimmed dump.

This is customer-impacting for our e-commerce vertical (we’re in the middle of a high-traffic window). Can Redwood join an urgent bridge and confirm an ETA for mitigation? Procurement also wants to know whether we’ll need a formal credit request.

—Samir
CrestGate, Head of Engineering
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
To: david.kim@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 08:23:18 -0700
Subject: Re: Severe latency spike and 5xx bursts impacting checkout

> We’re seeing a dramatic increase in latency and a spike in 5xx errors on calls to Redwood’s text-generation endpoint (model: rdx-large-v2) starting ~07:50 PT.

Folks — this is exec-level. I’m standing up a short war-room now. Immediate asks:
1) Markus — can you own the triage (logs, top error class, hot shards, model variant fallback) and post hourly updates to the PagerDuty incident (PD-8921)?

3) Laura — be ready for a call with Samir and their execs around commercial remediation (credits / SLA).
4) Monica — partner on the customer status and keep procurement thread synced.

War-room: Zoom (joining link in PD), cadence: 15m for the first hour, then 30m. I’ll lead the stakeholder comms after we have the first triage snapshot.

I’m adding logs they attached to the drive. Team, confirm when you’re on the bridge.

—Naomi
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: markus.klein@redwood.ai
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai, david.kim@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 08:31:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Severe latency spike and 5xx bursts impacting checkout

On Sun, Sep 27, 2026 at 8:23 AM naomi.feldman@redwood.ai wrote:
> Folks — this is exec-level. I’m standing up a short war-room now.

On the bridge. Initial triage:
- Error class: downstream GPU OOM and a small rate of model-serving timeouts. Hit 5xx count spike from 07:47–08:10 PT, correlates with a sudden jump in long-context requests (avg seq len +70% for the account).
- Affected shard set: gpu-pool-7 (nodes 7–9) showing elevated CPU and memory paging before the 5xx burst.
- Mitigation attempted: temporary throttling of long-context requests for CrestGate routing policy; we rolled to rdx-large-quant (reduced memory) which cut 5xx by ~60% in one minute but latency still elevated for long requests.
- Next: we’ll scale an additional reserved node and enable aggressive kv-cache TTL to reduce repeated prefix work. I’ll post metrics snapshots to the drive and update PD.

Attaching a short snippet from logs:
[2026-09-27T07:52:09Z] model-infer: rdx-large-v2 node-8 OOM -> spawn fallback rdx-large-quant; 5xx; client crestgate (x-account-id=CRG-11)
[2026-09-27T07:54:33Z] queue-delay: mean=420ms (baseline 120ms)

—Markus
Sr. SRE, Inference Platform

Thanks, Markus. Customer impact estimate (preliminary):
- Affected merchants: ~18 mid-market sellers using CrestGate checkout (approx 12% of their traffic during the window).
- Orders timing out: ~3.2k requests in the 07:45–08:30 PT window, estimated $48k GMV at risk during the hour.
- Business sensitivity: high (peak marketing campaign).

Customer facing status (draft):

Our engineers have identified a model-memory pressure event on our serving pool and implemented a fallback which has reduced failures. We continue to scale additional capacity and will provide a follow-up within 60 minutes with a mitigation timeline and next steps.

Monica — please align the wording; Laura — be prepared to escalate commercial ask if they request credits.

—David
Head of Customer Success

On Sun, Sep 27, 2026 at 9:02 AM david.kim@redwood.ai wrote:
> Customer facing status (draft):

Samir — quick update from the war-room: our engineers identified model-serving memory pressure on the pool handling your traffic and implemented an emergency fallback that has already reduced the 5xx rate by ~60%. We are actively provisioning additional reserved capacity and applying caches to common prefixes to lower end-to-end latency.

Expected next update: 11:00 PT with targeted mitigation ETA or further actions.

We appreciate your patience — we’ll stay on the bridge until this is stabilized.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Support, Redwood Inference
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, david.kim@redwood.ai, monica.patel@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Exec summary & stakeholder comms — CrestGate incident (wrap 15:42 PT)

Summary of actions & commitments for execs:
- What happened: a sudden burst of long-context requests from CrestGate caused model memory pressure on gpu-pool-7 resulting in OOMs and a short series of 5xx errors (07:47–08:10 PT).
- Immediate mitigations: fallback to quantized model and temporary throttling of long-context routing; scale-up + cache TTL changes reduced 5xxs by ~90% and normalized queue latency to within 1.3x baseline by 10:50 PT.
- Customer impact: ~3.2k timed-out requests; estimated revenue at risk $48k during the spike window. No data exfiltration or persisted loss reported.
- Customer comms: Monica sent a public update at 10:05 PT; David will lead the follow-up with a formal impact and remediation note.
- Commercial: Laura, if CrestGate requests a credit, we should propose a capped one-week credit tied to verified lost transactions (pending legal review).
- Next: Draft SLA addendum for long-context workloads (attachment draft). Action owner: Laura + Legal (ETA 48h).
- Postmortem: Ops to produce a 72-hour postmortem with root cause, mitigations, and long-term routing policy changes. Owner: Markus.

Attachments: crestgate_error_dump_20260927.log, proposed_sla_addendum_draft.docx
Links: PD-8921, Drive telemetry, JIRA-OPS-8412

Thanks team — strong response. Please mark any open items in the PD incident and update the JIRA ticket. I’ll send an executive note to Samir + their CRO summarizing commitments.

—Naomi
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
